title: A Markov chain forgetting where it started
sub: Each node shows the probability of that weather on day n.

frames.caption: Day 0: it is rainy for certain. Tomorrow's chances: after a sunny day 70% sun, 20% cloud, 10% rain; after a cloudy day 30/40/30; after a rainy day 20/40/40. Those rows form the transition matrix P.
Day 1: probability flows along the arrows: μ₁ = μ₀P.
Day 2. Distance from the long-run distribution: 0.122.
Day 3. Distance from the long-run distribution: 0.056.
Day 5. Distance from the long-run distribution: 0.012.

Day 10: Sunny 46.2%, Cloudy 30.8%, Rainy 23.1%. The starting state is forgotten: this is the stationary distribution π (πP = π), and it is the same whichever state you start in. The gap shrinks by |λ₂| = 0.46 each day.
